design.singleTruth: No second journal or store. Company entries are 11 domain-namespaced journal types (CRM_*, FIN_*, LEGAL_*) in the existing hash-chained Work OS journal, under the same process lock, tenant scope, idempotency map and fail-closed load. WorkOsStore.apply delegates company types to core/company/apply.ts; domain modules own validation, state machines and replay checks. Writes go through WorkOsStore.companyWrite (lock plus disk re-verification), reads through companyRead (fail-closed guard).
design.crm: accounts, contacts (name, optional role and email; PII never written to audit), opportunities (LEAD->QUALIFIED->PROPOSAL->WON, LOST from any open stage, WON/LOST terminal; amount integer minor units plus ISO 4217 shaped code).
design.finance: invoices DRAFT->ISSUED->PARTIALLY_PAID->PAID and ISSUED->VOID; line items integer minor units; totals computed server-side (a client totalMinor is accepted by the schema but ignored); status derived only from net recorded payments (ISSUED is never PAID); payments are separate append-only records; overpayment and currency mismatch rejected; corrections are REVERSAL records (same amount, one reversal per payment, a reversal cannot be reversed); void only for ISSUED invoices with zero net payments; invoice numbers INV-000001.. are per-tenant and rebuilt on replay.
design.legal: contracts DRAFT->SENT->SIGNED|DECLINED|EXPIRED; SIGNED requires documentSha256 (64 hex), signerName and signedAt (enforced in the API schema, in the domain function and again on journal replay); evidence fields are rejected for any other target; an opportunity link is only a validated reference and never creates, signs or advances a contract.
design.replayChecks: Every company journal entry is re-validated on load (shape, tenant ownership of references, state-machine legality, recomputed invoice totals, payment/currency/overpayment, reversal consistency, invoice number sequence, signature evidence). A hash-valid but semantically forged entry makes the store tampered (503 fail-closed).
design.api: GET/POST /v1/company/accounts, contacts, opportunities, invoices, contracts; POST opportunities/:id/stage, invoices/:id/issue, invoices/:id/void, contracts/:id/transition; POST /v1/company/payments (payment or reversal body); additional read-only GET /v1/company/payments. Write gate order GLOBAL_STOP 423 -> action-gateway 403 -> strict Ajv 400 (additionalProperties false). Creates take idempotencyKey (replay 200, different payload 409). Error bodies carry only fixed codes.
